title: The Glorious Revolution (1688)
key_facts: Overthrow of King James II and accession of William III and Mary II
Established a constitutional monarchy and affirmed parliamentary supremacy
Passed the English Bill of Rights (1689) limiting royal power
causes: Conflict over religious toleration and fears of a Catholic absolutist monarchy
Power struggles between Crown and Parliament after the English Civil War
Invitation to William of Orange by English political elites
outcome: Regular parliaments, free elections, and freedom of speech in Parliament
Model for later constitutional developments and revolutions

figures.name: William III of Orange
figures.role: Invited to assume the English throne

impacts: Strengthened parliamentary government and the rule of law
Influenced Enlightenment political thought (Locke) and Atlantic revolutions
Shaped British fiscal‑military state and foreign policy
